title: Structured SDEs for Realized GARCH: Continuous-Time Volatility Modelling and Component-Level Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.17732v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a structured continuous-time stochastic volatility model for one-day-ahead integrated-variance forecasting. The model introduces a jointly evolving realized-measure state that feeds directly into latent variance dynamics, while correlated Brownian innovations capture return-linked dependence. Parameters are estimated through simulation-based predictive learning, and Monte Carlo simulation forecasts integrated variance. Across 17 equity indices, the proposed model shows strong out-of-sample performance relative to GARCH, GARCH-It\^o, Realized GARCH, HAR, and HEAVY benchmarks under QLIKE, MSE, and MAE. Ablation results show that realized-measure feedback provides substantial incremental forecasting value within the proposed framework, while return-linked Brownian dependence contributes more modest complementary gains. translated_title: 面向已实现GARCH的结构化随机微分方程：连续时间波动率建模与成分级分析
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种结构化连续时间随机波动率模型，用于提前一天的积分方差预测。该模型引入了一个联合演化的已实现测度状态，直接输入到潜在方差动态中，同时相关的布朗运动创新项捕捉与收益相关的依赖结构。模型参数通过基于模拟的预测学习方法进行估计，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟预测积分方差。在17个股票指数上的实证结果表明，该模型在QLIKE、MSE和MAE指标下，相对于GARCH、GARCH-Itô、Realized GARCH、HAR和HEAVY等基准模型展现出强大的样本外预测性能。消融实验显示，已实现测度反馈在所提出的框架内提供了可观的增量预测价值，而与收益相关的布朗依赖关系则带来了较为温和的补充收益。这些结果支持将测量驱动的信息直接纳入连续时间潜在波动率建模中。
tldr: 该论文提出一种结构化连续时间随机波动率模型，通过已实现测度状态直接反馈到潜在方差动态中来预测积分方差，在17个股票指数上展现出优于GARCH、Realized GARCH等基准模型的样本外预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structured continuous-time stochastic volatility model that feeds a jointly evolving realized-measure state directly into latent variance dynamics, achieving superior out-of-sample integrated-variance forecasting performance over GARCH, Realized GARCH, and other benchmarks across 17 equity indices.
